% ==================== FEATURED PROJECTS ====================
\section*{Projects}

% PROJECT 1
\textbf{Smart Environmental Monitoring System} \,|\, Individual project \,|\, \faGithub\ \href{https://github.com/SangNguyen-232/IoT-Env-Monitor}{GitHub Repo} \hfill \textit{Jul 2026 -- Nov 2026} \\
\textbf{Stack:} ESP32-S3, C/C++, FreeRTOS, TFLite Micro, Python, Express, PostgreSQL, Docker, Cloudflare Tunnel
\begin{itemize}
    \item Built ESP32-S3 firmware with seven FreeRTOS tasks. Read air temperature and humidity from a DHT20 over I2C every 5\,s, updated the LCD and sampled soil moisture on a separate ADC input.
    \item Ran inference outside the mutex and discarded results if the sample sequence or acquisition time had changed.
    \item Trained and quantized a fan model for 30\,s OFF/HOLD/ON forecasts. The 5,536-byte INT8 model uses a 4\,KiB tensor arena and scored 87.28\% on 3,600 held-out synthetic episodes in desktop tests, versus 82.94\% for linear extrapolation.
    \item Implemented relay hysteresis with 10\,s minimum on/off times. A matching ON forecast scoring at least 0.80 can trigger an early start in AI mode. In automatic modes, invalid or stale air readings ($>$15\,s) force the relay off.
    \item Kept fan control local during outages, streamed readings over WebSocket, and deployed the Dockerized Express and PostgreSQL API remotely via an outbound Cloudflare Tunnel and Workers VPC without opening inbound ports.
\end{itemize}

\vspace{1.5pt}

% PROJECT 2
\textbf{FPGA Vending Machine Prototype} \,|\, Team of 5 \,|\, \faGithub\ \href{https://github.com/SangNguyen-232/FPGA-Vending-System}{GitHub Repo} \hfill \textit{Oct 2024 -- Dec 2024} \\
\textbf{Stack:} Verilog, Xilinx Vivado, Icarus Verilog, Digilent Arty Z7-20 (125\,MHz XDC clock constraint)
\begin{itemize}
    \item Co-designed four-product vending RTL with one-hot selection, admin price and stock controls, and credit checks before each purchase. A successful sale updates both balance and inventory.
    \item Used two-stage synchronizers and debounce counters on four pushbuttons. Built a nine-state FSM to drive a $16\times2$ character LCD over an 8-bit parallel bus.
    \item RTL simulation checked credit and stock for accepted and rejected purchases and traced 32 character writes in the first LCD frame.
\end{itemize}
